title: Career Roadmap · Electrician
summary: No universal percentage cutoff applies. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: National / state
blocks.text: Check the National Scholarship Portal and Andhra Pradesh scholarship portals for eligible ITI students.

blocks.label: Skill training
blocks.text: Investigate current government-funded training through Skill India and state skill-development programmes.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: Apprentices may receive a stipend under applicable apprenticeship rules; verify the current contract and stipend terms.

blocks.label: Eligibility
blocks.text: Depends on the scheme, institute, income, category, domicile and course.
No universal percentage cutoff applies. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Electrical fundamentals, wiring, tools, measurement, circuit diagrams and safety.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Domestic and industrial wiring, motors, transformers, testing, fault-finding and maintenance.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship / OJT
blocks.text: Practice under qualified supervision and follow approved procedures.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Training-board wiring circuit; lighting and socket layout; motor-control demonstration; electrical energy-use audit.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Railways, power utilities, public-sector undertakings and government workshops when vacancies are advertised.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Electrical contractors, manufacturing plants, building-services companies, solar installers and maintenance firms.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Installation, preventive maintenance, testing, motor control and fault diagnosis.
Search opportunities through the official Apprenticeship India portal. Availability and selection depend on the employer and current vacancies.

blocks.text: Industrial wiring, motor control, electrical maintenance, power distribution, solar installations and electrical testing.

blocks.label: Safety rule
blocks.text: Never work on live electrical equipment unless specifically authorized and trained under an approved safe-work procedure.

Qualification assessment for internationally trained workers.

blocks.text: An Indian ITI certificate does not automatically authorize independent electrical work abroad. Verify current programme entry, qualification recognition and licensing rules.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Electrical Technician, Maintenance Electrician, Electrical Installer, Industrial Electrical Technician.

blocks.text: Australia, Canada, Germany, UK and New Zealand.
Licensing, apprenticeship rules, language requirements and work authorization differ by country and region. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

ITI Trainee ↓ Apprentice Electrician ↓ Electrician / Technician ↓ Senior Electrician / Specialist ↓ Electrical Supervisor / Maintenance Lead ↓ Contractor / Technical Trainer / Business Owner, subject to applicable authorization.

CLASS 10 ↓ ITI ELECTRICIAN / WIREMAN ↓ PRACTICAL TRAINING + ELECTRICAL SAFETY ↓ APPRENTICESHIP / SUPERVISED EXPERIENCE ↓ ELECTRICIAN / TECHNICIAN ↓ SPECIALIZATION + EXPERIENCE ↓ SENIOR TECHNICIAN / SUPERVISOR / ADVANCED STUDY
Official starting points

items.text: DGT — CTS Trade List and Eligibility

blocks.text: DGT lists the Electrician CTS trade as a two-year programme with Class 10 and Science/Mathematics or an eligible vocational-subject pathway; the Wireman trade has separate entry criteria. Confirm the current trade and institute details before admission.
